title: Smart Data Models - ERA EVR - VehicleRegistrationCase
description:
Vehicle Registration Case (era:VehicleRegistrationCase's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Vehicle Registrations can be created and modified using a specific Registration Case as listed in `3.2.2.   Registration cases` of the EVR Decision.

Each registration case will have as its scope:
- a set of vehicles of which the registration needs creating/updating.
- if present, the authorisation delivered for these vehicles and/or vehicle type to which they belong. Inherits attributes from era:Case (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VehicleRegistrationCase'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

additionalVehicleConditions.description: Property. Identification of applicable bilateral or multilateral agreements such as RIV, RIC, TEN, TEN-CW, TEN-GE, …. Other conditions can be added elsewhere. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'International Vehicle Agreements' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/international-vehicle-agreements/InternationalVehicleAgreements), 5 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

hasNationalRegistrationProperty.description: Relationship. Links a vehicle registration case to a national-level registration property defined by a member state. Each member state may define its own set of such properties, identified by a national property identifier string. This avoids creating individual era: predicates for each member-state-specific registration field.

registeringMemberState.description: Property. Indicates the member state where a vehicle type has been registered. Not to be confused with Area Of Use of the registration (deduced from the authorisation). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

registrationCaseType.description: Property. Type of registration case according to Annex 2 - 3.2.2 Registration Cases (e.g., new registration, modification, change of ECM). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Vehicle authorisation cases' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/vr-regcases/VehicleRegistrationCase), 18 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

vehicleDependentCondition.description: Relationship. Conditions for use of the vehicle and other restrictions on how the vehicle may be used

verificationCCS.description: Property. Unique number for EC declarations in accordance with Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/250.

verificationRSTWAG.description: Property. Unique number for EC declarations in accordance with Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/250.

concerns.description: Relationship. holds as material content, constitutes, embodies the material components of the Scope. Target type (Scope) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

constitutes.description: Relationship. forms a complete, independent, possibly sole part of a request Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

permissionType.description: Property. the detailed process which constitutes this Case's permission conditions Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

status.description: Property. the status of the Request, or constituting Case(s), as it is being treated by the PermittingBody Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.
